request: Replace the approved RGB-only hand estimates with robot hands
status: Two short visual hand-replacement previews completed; not a physically validated demonstration
tests: tests/test_rgb_robot_hands.py plus previous adapter/compositing tests: 11 passed

method.hand: Sharpa native vendor geometry and joint limits; scale 1.0
method.wrist: Six virtual floating DOFs, not a physical R1 arm
method.camera: Same virtual focal as the accepted WiLoR output (37500px at 1920x1080); preserves its reprojection rather than treating virtual translation as calibrated depth
method.initialization: Official Analyzing Key Objectives retargeter, author ablation 2 retaining actual fingertip separation; adapted floating-wrist URDF
method.refinement: Custom bounded pixel reprojection / distal direction / relative shape objective against WiLoR landmarks, with weak joint regularization
method.mapping: WiLoR wrist-thumb-index-middle-ring-little reordered to existing Sharpa wrist-index-middle-ring-little-thumb
method.composite: Robot RGB where robot geometry rasterizes; no object matte or inpainting applied
method.old_reference: Previous EgoDex-driven native-size paper_actual_distance output includes robot arms; qualitative reference, not controlled arm-ablation comparison

results.limits: No joint-limit excess in saved solutions
results.optimizer: All 132 side/frame refinements reached the 250-iteration budget rather than convergence tolerance. Finite bounded preview solutions, not claimed optimal. Per-frame status saved
results.visual: Inspected middle and end comparisons; native robot fingertips follow visible hand/tool region substantially better than prior EgoDex-driven rendering, but object ordering and remaining human pixels are unresolved

important_limits: WiLoR is an estimator, not ground truth
Virtual-camera wrist translations (including 12-22m depth) must not be sent to hardware or treated as actual room trajectories
No object geometry, contact force, penetration or self-collision validation
No removal of exposed original human hand pixels
This is hand-only visual replacement, not connected whole-arm retargeting
preservation: Old results and production pipeline unchanged; no training, commit, upload or push
